purpose: Follow the two solid branches in Figure 1: the experts receive the same token state and run in parallel, not one after the other. The dotted path supplies mixing weights. Attention and the surrounding decoder remain shared; routing replaces the FFN sublayer.
alt: A router sends one token state to two of eight parallel feedforward experts. Router weights scale the two expert outputs before they are summed.
caption: **Figure 1.** One token, two selected FFN experts. Reproduced from Jiang et al., Figure 1; figure crop, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).[^report]
